tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sgrub thabs nor bu'i phreng ba'i lhan thabs gser gyi pa ṭa zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

sgrub thabs nor bu'i phreng ba'i lhan thabs gser gyi pa ṭa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas pa'i// ye shes gcig bsdus 'jam pa'i dbyangs// bdag snying pad+mor rtag mchod nas// blo dman slob dpon khur ldan pas| |rdo rje theg pa'i rjes gnang tshe// dad ldan slob ma'i tshogs rnams la// lhag bsam ngang nas 'di skad zlo// sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob par bgyi ba'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das che ge mo'i cho ga'i rjes su gnang ba gsan nas thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa'i thugs bskyed lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang bcas nyan dgos pa'i tshul ni/ ji skad du/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod// ces gsungs pa ltar gsal btab nas/ gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ yid ches shing khungs btsun pa bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa gnyis te/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen pos/ brgyud pa las brgyud pa'i chos zab cing ngo mtshar/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'di nyid kyi brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ a bha yā ka ra gup+ta/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ shu bhā ka ra gup+ta/ su tsa ri gup+ta/ shan+ta shrī bha dra/ shong lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ dpang blo gros brtan pa/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen| sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor pa kun bzang*/ bla ma rin chen mchog ldan/ slob dpon bla ma/ rje zhwa dmar pa chos kyi grags pa/ rgyal dbang rin chen phun tshogs/ mnyam med rin chen dpal/ rje btsun bi dā ra ṇa sam+pān+na/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la dgyes bzhin du stsal ba ni bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dam nyams dang 'dres khyer gyi sel med cing*/ ltar snang gya tshom gyi lhad ma zhugs pa'i smin grol gyi gdams pa yang dag pa'i brgyud pa dang ldan pa'i brgyud pa rnam par dag pa yin no// brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa ston pa la yang*/

gang gis dbang bskur ba rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ spyi dang*/ bye brag gnyis las/ spyi'i mtshan nyid ni/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las gsungs pa ltar dang*/ bye brag 'dul ba ston pa'i bla ma ni/ brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang lnga phrugs nyi shu rtsa lnga dang ldan pa/ byang sems ston pa'i slob dpon ni/ sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ bla ma sdom la gnas shing mkhas// nus dang ldan la blang bar bya// zhes so// rdo rje theg pa'i slob dpon ni/ gur gyi brgyad pa las/ brtan cing zab mo'i chos dang ldan// rig pa'i gnas rnams kun la mkhas// sbyin sreg dkyil 'khor sngags shes shing*// rab gnas gtor ma'i pha rol son// de nyid bcu po rnam par rig /nyan thos spyod pa skyong byed cing*// sngags kyi theg pa'i rim par gus// gzugs ldan mthong na dga' ba dang*// dkyil 'khor bri mkhas bzlas par ldan// rtsa ba'i ltung ba rab spangs shing*// sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes// 'jig rten kun la bde ster ba// zhes mtshan nyid bco brgyad dang ldan pa spyir btang du gsungs la/ sgos su rgyud sde so sor rang gi mtshan nyid so sor gsungs pa rnams so// nyan pa po slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ sdom 'byung las/ brtan cing dul la blo gros ldan// bzod ldan drang zhing g.yo rgyu med// mi dge bcu ni yongs su spangs// sems can rnams la byams par blta// 'bar ba'i me dang dug sogs bzhin// pha rol rdzas la sred mi byed// rtag par rgyun du bla ma mchod// dam chos lta ba la spro zhing*// rtag tu sbyin sreg la sogs dga'// 'jig rten pha rol mngon 'dod pa// rab bsngags slob ma de rnams la// sbyin bya dkyil 'khor dam pa'o// zhes sogs mang du gsungs shing*/ khyad par med du mi rung ba'i mtshan nyid gnyis ni/ slob dpon a bha yas/ de rnams kyang dad pas rdo rje sems dpa'i sdom pa don du gnyer zhing*/

rdo rje theg pa las ston pa gzhan mi 'tshol bar gyur na'o// zhes sngags sdom la don gnyer che zhing rdo rje theg pa la lhag par mos pa ni shin tu gal che la 'di gnyis med na rdo rje theg pa'i slob mar 'os pa ma yin no// de ltar bshad pa de rnams las ldog pa'i slob dpon dang slob ma ni spang bar bya ba yin gyi/ bskur bya dbang gi rnam par bzhag pa ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa des/ rgyu la mos pa rgyu'i chos kyi// 'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas// 'bras bu'i theg pa nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus su 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa'i bstan pa ni| rdo rje rtse mo las/ smin pa dang ni grol ba'i lam// sangs rgyas byang chub bstan pa'i mchog /ces smin grol gnyis su ma 'dus pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa gzhan du med la/ de yang grol lam gyi sngon du dbang bskur 'gro dgos te/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng bar/ thog mar slob dpon gang gi tshe// blo ldan yang dag dbang bskur na// rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor la// de yi tshe na snod du 'gyur// zhes so// dbang bskur thob pa'i phan yon ni/ sgron gsal las/ dngos grub thams cad ni dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba nyid las 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ gsang ba'i mdzod las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na// skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur// de yi skye ba bdun na ni// ma bsgom par yang sangs rgyas 'gyur// zhes dang*/ dam tshig lnga pa las/ ma bsgom na yang ltung med na// skye ba bcu drug dag la 'grub// ces dbang bskur nas lam nyams su blang na| rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti ltar tshe 'dir mchog thob la/ ma bsgom na'ang dam tshig bsrung na skye ba bdun nam/ tha na'ang skye ba bcu drug gi mthar dbang gi yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel te/ 'tshang mi rgya ba mi srid par gsungs so// dbang ma thob pa'i nyes pa ni/

sangs rgyas thod pa las/ dper na pi waṃ sbyor sogs kun// rgyu dang bral na rdung mi rung*// de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni// sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur// zhes dang*/ phyag chen thig ler/ gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis// dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa// slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar 'gro// zhes gsungs pas/ dbang ma thob par sngags bzla ba dang*/ bsam gtan bsgoms kyang don mi 'grub cing khyad par dbang med par rgyud shes pa'i nga rgyal gyis rgyud don rim pa gnyis la sogs pa bshad na/ dpon slob gnyis ka rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung ba'i phyir ro// dbang de dag gi rnam par dbye ba ni/ ye shes thig ler/ chu dang cod pan dbang bskur dag /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags// rdo rje dril bu de bzhin ming*// spyod pa'i rgyud du yongs su grags// phyir mi ldog pa yi ni dbang*// rnal 'byor rgyud du gsal bar grags// de bzhin drug gi bye brag dbang*// de ni slob dpon dbang zhes bya// rnal 'byor bla ma yi ni mtshan// gsang ba yi ni dbang rgyal 'dod// shes rab ye shes bla na med// bzhi pa la yang de bzhin no// zhes gsungs pa'i bya spyod rnal 'byor gsum gyi chu cod pan/ rdor dril ming slob dpon gyi dbang rnams dang*/ bla med kyi rigs dbang lnga slob dpon gyi dbang rnams dang*/ ming 'dra yang bskur tshul la khyad par shin tu che'o// gzhan yang bya rgyud sogs nas bshad pa'i zan ril gyis lha'i rigs nges par byas nas/ de'i sngags lung sbyin pa tsam ni sngags gtad pa'i cho ga zhes grags la/ 'di dang bla med kyi sngags gtad pa'i cho ga gnyis mi gcig /yang bla med la bum chu rigs dbang lnga'i dam tshig gsum sogs gtad pas slob dpon gyi dbang*/ thod pa'i bdud rtsis gsang dbang sher dbang rig ma'i brtul zhugs sogs phyogs gcig

/bzhi pa tshig gis sbyin zhing 'jug pa sogs spros pa chung la/ dngos gzhi mdor bsdus pa ni/ dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba zhes bshad/ yang lha bsgom pa'i dmigs pa phog nas sngags bzlas lung sbyin zhing dbang gi bya ba gzhan med pa ni rig pa gtad pa zhes grags/ yang lha'i dmigs pa bsgom du bcug cing sngags bzlas lung dang bsam gtan nye tshe ba bsgom du bcug nas bdag mdun gyi bya ba gzhan med pa la byin rlabs zhes bshad/ yang rjes su gnang ba la'ang bdag mdun gyi bya ba rdzogs par byas nas/ sngon 'gro skyabs sems gsol ba gdab pa tsam gyi mjug tu lha sgom pa sku/ bzlas lung gsung*/ ting 'dzin sgom pa thugs kyi rjes gnang tsam byed pa ni rjes gnang bsdus pa'i lugs/ sngon 'gro gong ltar las/ lha dam tshig pa bskyed| ye shes pa bcug /dbang lha spyan drangs nas chu dbang nyi tshe ba bskur te rigs bdag gis rgyas btab/ bzlas lung dang lha rang 'dra ba slob mar bstim zhing ting nge 'dzin bsgom/ mthar dam bca'i lung dang bcas pa ni rjes gnang rgyas pa'i lugs/ de la sogs pa gzhan yang yi dam dang chos skyong gi smin lam tha dad pa so sor 'byung ba rnams las/ 'dir ni rjes gnang rgyas pa'i lugs kyi dbang bskur ba yin zhing*/ de yang thog mar bdag mdun bum pa bskyed cing mchod bstod/ bzlas pa/ gtor 'bul/ bdag nyid 'jug pa sogs slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams legs par grub/ rdo rje slob ma'i ngo skal du gyur pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sogs sngon du song zin pas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ ji skad du/ pus btsugs thal mo sbyar byas nas| |nyan sogs 'dod pas gsol gsum gdab// ces pa ltar/ gsol gdab kyi don yang*/ kun mkhyen zhes pa sangs rgyas te/ de'i thugs ye shes thams cad kyi phung po gcig bsdus kyi ngo bo slob dpon yin pas de la gsol ba gdab bya ni/ srid pa'i 'khor lo sbyong ba ste/

ji skad du/ kun gzhi'i lte ba rab brtan cing*// rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis rtsibs// sdug bsngal mu khyud kyis bskor ba// srid pa'i 'khor lo gzhom du gsol// zhes pa'i don ltar yin la/ tshul de lta bu las thar ba'i thabs ni/ de ring bshad bya'i rin po che'i gter lta bu dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba/ lhag pa'i lha'i rjes su gnang ba ste/ gtso bo zhes pa ni 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ste/ de dang tha mi dad pa'i slob dpon gyis bdag la bka' drin stsol zhig /ces pa'i don yin pas yid la bsam nas rjes zlos bya dgos so// de rjes lnga rnam dag rgyun bshags/ rdo rje gur nas gsungs pa yang*/ tshig rkang dang po sdig bshags kyi rten dkon mchog gsum ngos bzung ba ste/ 'di la'ang sangs rgyas dang*/ chos dang*/ dge 'dun gsum ni kun rdzob phyi'i dkon mchog gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang*/ de'i rdo rje theg pa'i gsang chos dang*/ 'khor gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams ni kun rdzob nang gi dkon mchog gsum/ rang sems spros bral sangs rgyas chos sku/ de'i rang gshis mtha' bral zung 'jug gi chos/ de'i rang mdangs gang shar sprul pa'i dge 'dun ste/ don dam blo 'das kyi dkon mchog gsum/ yang na sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul sku/ lung ni dam chos/ nyan rang gi dge 'dun ni theg dman nye tshe ba'i dkon mchog gsum/ sangs rgyas chos kyi sku/ chos lam dang 'gog bden/ byang sems 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gsum ni theg chen rgyu'i dkon mchog gsum/ sangs rgyas yan lag bdun ldan/ chos rdo rje theg pa/ 'khor dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma ni bla med 'bras bu'i theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum yin la/ 'dir ni theg dman dang kun rdzob phyi'i dkon mchog gsum ma yin no// rkang pa gnyis pas dus gsum du bsags pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba ni rang bzhin gyis kha na ma tho ba yin la/ sdom pa gsum la 'gal ba ni bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba ste/

de gnyis cho gas khas blang ba yin min tsam las 'bras bu 'dra ba'i phyir/ mgon po 'bri gung pas bcas dang rang bzhin gcig /sdig ltung yang gcig par gsungs shing*/ mi dge ba'i las rang gis bgyis pa/ gzhan la bgyid du stsal ba/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba sogs sgrib gsum bag chags dang bcas pa ni bshags bya'o// rkang pa gsum pas/ bdag gzhan 'khor 'das kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams la dga' spro yi rang bsgom pa'o| |rkang pa bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung zhes pas bde stong lhan cig skyes pa don dam pa'i ye shes rdo rje ni sangs rgyas kyi byang chub ste/ de nyid 'dzin par dam bca' ba ni don dam byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'o// rkang pa lnga pa dang drug pas sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur phyir skyabs su 'gro ba'o// rkang pa bdun pa dang brgyad pas smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'o// rkang pa dgu pa dang bcu pa bcu gcig pa gsum gyis 'jug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'o// rkang pa bcu gnyis pas ni theg chen gyi bsngo bas rgyas gdab pa ste/ lnga rnam par dag pa yin la/ 'dir rdo rje theg pa'i ston pa ni sprul sku theg dman gyi ston pa ltar mya ngan las mi 'da' ba dang*/ chos mi gsung ba'i tshul mi ston par dus rtag pa rgyun du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du bzhugs pa ste/ slob dpon ye shes snying pos/ sprul pa'i sku ni mya ngan las// 'da' bar ston gyi gcig shos min// zhes gsungs pas/ bdun rnam dag ni sprul sku la dbul gyi/ 'dir lnga rnam dag ni rdo rje theg pa'i khyad chos yin pas tshul de lta bur 'dun pa gsal btab nas rgyun bshags lan gsum bya'o// sku'i rjes gnang gi gsol gdab la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa ni rdo rje sems dpa' yin te/ gur gyi tha ma las/ gang phyir rdo rje sems dpa' ni// de nyid slob dpon gzugs bzung ste// sems can phan gdags dmigs nas ni// tha mal pa yi tshul gyis gnas// zhes rdo rje 'chang rdo rje sems dpa' ni slob dpon mtshan ldan gyi ming yin la/

de nyid kyi dgongs gsol nas/ bdag ni 'gro ba'i don du gtso chen te 'khor lo'i dbang phyug yin la de dang dbyer med pa'i slob dpon khyed la gsol ba 'debs kyi gang dgos na/ phyag rgya'i ye shes te/ de ni sku yongs rdzogs bskyed pa'i don te/ brtag gnyis las/ nges par bcom ldan he ru kaḥ /phyag rgya'i tshogs dang bcas pa bri// zhes gsungs pas sku bsgom pa ni/ sku'i rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi yin pas sems ma yeng bar bsgom pa gal che ste/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ brjed ngas blo la 'od dpag med sogs dang*// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobs// zhes sogs gsungs pas ma yeng bar bsgom par bya'o// brtan byed chu dbang gi skabs dbang lha de bzhin gshegs pa dang gshegs ma/ sems dpa' dang sems ma/ khro bo dang khro mo ste gdan gsum tshang ba spyan drangs pa la slob dpon gyis gsol ba 'debs pa'i don/ rdo rje can ni rdo rje 'chang gi mtshan yin la/ sangs rgyas ni rigs lnga sogs kyi mtshan yin pas rdo rje 'chang gis 'og min du 'gro ba'i don du rigs lnga sogs la 'khor 'das kyi yon tan thams cad kyi bdag nyid dbang ji ltar stsal ba de ltar slob ma 'di la'ang stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba'i don yin la/ dbang bskur ba'i tshe slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis ka bsam 'dun rtse gcig tu bya/ bskur tshig dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni don dam ye shes kyi ngo bo yin la/ de nyid kun rdzob du lha dang bum chu'i rnam pa gsang sngags thabs mkhas pa'i don te/ 'di la ni khams gsum pa'i dbang phyug drag po dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ khyab 'jug la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i dregs byed chen po rnams dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis kyang phyag bgyi ba'i 'os yin te/ gur gyi tha ma las/ de phyir slob dpon mdun byon na// de bzhin gshegs rnams phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// de ltar sangs rgyas kyis kyang phyag 'tshal ba'i dgos pa ci zhe na/

sangs rgyas gyur to 'tshal gyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba thams cad las byung ba'i gnas yin pa'i phyir/ de lta bus dbang bskur ba'i don yin no// rigs bdag rgyas gdab pa ni/ ji skad du/ rgyu la 'bras bus rgyas gdab cing*// 'bras bu la yang rgyus rgyas gdab// ces pas rgyu la 'bras bus rgyas gdab pa ni/ rgyu pad+ma'i rigs spyan ras gzigs la 'bras bu 'dod chags dag pa 'od dpag med kyis rgyas gdab pa lta bu/ 'bras bu la rgyus rgyas gdab pa ni/ 'bras bu don yod grub pa'i rigs can sgrol ma la/ rgyu 'dod chags dag pa sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyis rgyas gdab pa lta bu/ rgyu la rgyus rgyas gdab pa ni/ rgyu 'dod chags dag pa rdo rje phag mo la rgyu gti mug dag pa rnam snang gis rgyas gdab pa lta bu/ 'bras bu la 'bras bus rgyas gdab pa ni/ rdo rje'i rigs 'bras bu zhe sdang dag pa 'khor lo sdom pa la rigs bdag zhe sdang dag pa'i 'bras bu me long ye shes kyi rang bzhin mi bskyod pas rgyas gdab pa lta bu ste mu bzhir gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'dir ni bzhi ka skabs thob gzhung bzhin bya ba yin no// gsung gi rjes gnang gi skabs sngar ltar las/ sngags kyi dbang bskur ba ni ye shes chen po ste rlung sngags dbyer med pa gzhom med stong pa'i rang sgra nā da zhes sgra tsam gyis mtshon pa de ni lha thams cad kyi dngos grub bskul ba'i don yin pas stsol zhig go| |dmigs pa'i tshe sngags phreng bdag mdun gnyis ka'i sngags phreng slob ma la spro ba dang*/ slob ma'i kha nang du 'jug pa dang rna bar 'jug pa sogs lugs mang zhing*/ sngags de nyid kyang skyon drug dang bral dgos te/ ji skad du/ bzlas brjod byed tshe mi myur mi dal zhing*// sgra cher mi dbyung ha cang chung ba'ang min// gug skyed klad kor tshig ni nyams pa min// smra bzhin ma yin gzhan du yeng bzhin min// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de rjes slob mas bdag gi bzung bar bgyi'i/

bdag la nye bar mdzod gsol ba'i tshe/ slob dpon gyis rjes su gnang bar bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das che ge mo 'di la stsal lags kyi 'go bar mdzod cig /sngags kyi dngos grub ni mchog sangs rgyas dang dman pa grub pa brgyad dang phrin las bzhi stsol zhig go// brtul zhugs brtan pa ni/ sku phyag rgya'i brtul zhugs bskyed rim brtan pa/ gsung sngags kyi brtul zhugs bzlas pa dang ma bral ba/ thugs bsam gtan gyi brtul zhugs ting nge 'dzin las ma yeng ba/ phrin las ni sangs rgyas pa'i tshe phrin las rdo rje'i theg pas 'gro don 'bad med du 'grub pa rgyu dus kyi dam bca' 'bras dus su rdzogs par mdzod cig pa'o// thugs kyi rjes gnang la gong ltar las/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis bdag la blo'i mchog mtshan 'dzin thams cad mthar byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin bskyed du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs rjes mdun bskyed bskul nas ting nge 'dzin sku ye shes sems dpa' dang*/ sngags ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' spros pa slob ma dam tshig sems dpar thim nas/ lha'i sku gsung thugs dang slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du byas ma thag /spros med rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ de'i tshul ji ltar zhe na/ 'jam dpal zhal lung las/ chos rnams gzugs la sogs pa nas// kun mkhyen bar gyi rang bzhin ni// nam mkha' dkyil ltar rnam dag pa'i// zab gsal gnyis med ye shes te// de ni dngos med sgom dngos med// dngos po thams cad dang bral ba// khams dang skye mched kyis ma zin// rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal ba// gdod nas dag pa nam mkha' bzhin// zhes dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ rang gi rig pa'i ye shes 'di// ngag gi lam 'das spyod yul te// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don la mnyam par bzhag pa ste| de yang bsal bzhag spang blang bsgom bya min te/

mgon po byams pas/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba'ang cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// zhes pa'i don ltar sgom mo// dam bca' lugs ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dang*/ slob dpon dgongs gsol nas/ de ring dbang thob pa'i rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du yi dam 'di mi spong bar lhag pa'i lhar 'dzin cing*/ de'i sngags ma chag par bzla ba dang*/ mgon po sogs chos skyong ba'i srung ma dam par bzung nas sngags ma chag par bzla ba khas blangs pas chag med du nyams su blang ba'i don yin pas nyams len gyi rkang 'dzugs pa'i phyir yin no// rjes su dam tshig bsdus nas bsrung ba ni/ gtso bo rdo rje slob dpon gyis ji ltar stsal ba ni nam yang mi byed par mi rung ste/ ji skad du/ gang phyir rdo rje slob dpon gyi// dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang gsungs| |de bas de la brnyas pa ni// rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang por gsungs// zhes so// gzhan yang de ring dbang thob nas bzung ste slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum ni/ slob dpon la phul zin pa ste/ bdag lus longs spyod snang srid yongs bzhes la// zhes phul zin pa'i phyir dang*/ phul nas ci byed na slob dpon gyi bran dang slob ma dang rjes su 'jug par byed pas de ltar gzung du gsol dang*/ rang gi lus longs spyod thams cad phul zin nas drug cha gcig dngos grub kyi slad du zhu bsam pas gnang bar gsol ba yin no// de rjes gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang slob dpon yon gyis mnyes par bya dgos te/ sdom 'byung las/ slob ma las ni yon blang bya// des kyang gus pas dbul bar bya// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ bla ma'i zhal snga mchod byas na// ci 'dod pa yi 'bras bu rnyed// ces dang*/ gur gyi brgyad pa las/ gang gis slob dpon mnyes ma byas// yang dag byang chub 'gro min nyid// ces sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/

slob dpon mnyes pa shin tu gal che bas so// zhes pa rnams rjes gnang gi skabs so sor bshad cing*/ blo ldan rnams kyis rgyas bshad lung rigs kyis brgyan pa nyid 'chad phyir tshul 'di tsam la ltos mi dgos na'ang*/ blo dman rnams la phan par sems so// smras pa/ rdo rje'i theg pa'i lam bzang la// rgyas dang bsdus dang 'tsham pa sogs// mkhas grub snga mas mang mdzad mod// de dag blo dman 'ga' 'ga' yis// rnyed cing rtogs par dka' ba'i phyir// rjes gnang lhan thabs bsdus pa 'di// kho bos bgyis mod 'ga' zhig gis// dbang gi sngon 'gro legs bshad dag /yin rlom 'brel med sna tshogs pa// skad gsang mthon pos smra ba mthong*// de la mkhas par rlom pa yi// slob ma dang bcas de dag kun// ba lang khyu las ches blun no// ji ltar bza' dang btung ba la// lan tshwa'i ro ni mthun pa ltar// de bzhin rjes gnang rnams la yang*/ legs bshad 'di dag kun tu rgyug /de phyir shes ldan gyis mthong yang*// 'di la 'khrul pa ma mchis so// 'di dge sems can thams cad la// sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo bar bgyi// de ltar sgrub thabs nor bu'i phreng ba'i rjes gnang rnams kyi lhan thabs 'di yang mnga' ris lha mo dkon mchog lhun grub kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas me glang zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu la/ 'bri klung chos phyug gi pho brang re'u mig lcang lo can gsang ba sngags kyi gan mdzod du mgyogs par sbyar ba dag go// //maṅga laṃ//
